title: Eggs to Spawn Eggs
description: Put any chicken egg into a stonecutter to apply the texture to the Egg
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c4811e638177525f867b610b1dbe419acb2608f.png)

Turn any chicken egg—white, brown, or blue—into every vanilla mob spawn egg using only your Stonecutter. Zero configuration, no commands, mods, resource packs, or extra setup.

## Installation

1. Download the `egg-to-spawn-eggs.zip`.  
2. Open your world folder and navigate to `datapacks/`.  
3. Drag the ZIP into `datapacks/`.  
4. Run `/reload` in-game or restart your world.

---

## Usage

1. Place any chicken egg (white, brown, or blue) in a Stonecutter.  
2. Browse the list of vanilla mobs.  
3. Take the spawn egg from the output slot and use it as usual.
